t: You're at Queen's College, a private day school for girls in the City of Westminster, with a prep school alongside for the youngest pupils. Frederick Denison Maurice founded it in 1848, working with a committee of patrons. He was an Anglican priest and theologian, and one of the founders of Christian socialism. In 1853 this became the first girls' school to be granted a Royal Charter for the furtherance of women's education. Until 2024, its patron had always been a British queen.
